result.fundName: ICICI Prudential US Bluechip Equity Fund - Direct Plan -  Growth

insights: ICICI Prudential US Bluechip Equity Fund - Direct Plan -  Growth marginally outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 0.49% (15.13% vs 14.65%).
Chance of beating benchmark is 61.8% — moderate consistency, below the 70% Golden Triangle threshold.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.16 vs benchmark 0.81, Sortino 1.70.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.16, volatility within 2% of the index.
Positive alpha of 19.61% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.29).
Drawdown profile is similar to benchmark (-20.26% vs -20.06%).
Rolling return range spans 12.47% to 17.36% (4.89 pp spread) — consistency score 77.
Failed criteria: Chance of Beating Benchmark.
